notes: Technical report on long-context (1M) training and inference for Qwen2.5-1M; no safety, alignment-risk, refusal, jailbreak, bias, or dangerous-capability section. All capability and preference benchmarks skipped under pilot safety-only rule (Passkey Retrieval, Needle-in-a-Haystack, RULER, LV-Eval, Longbench-Chat, MMLU-Pro, MMLU-redux, LiveBench, GPQA, MATH, GSM8K, HumanEval, MBPP, MultiPL-E, LiveCodeBench, IFEval, Arena-Hard, MT-Bench, and TTFT speed figures). Mentions of 'alignment with human preferences' and DPO refer to preference post-training, not safety evals. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M and Qwen2.5-Turbo are covered via rawModelName (not in seed). No external safety testers or risk framework decisions.
